items.title: Chico Hamilton interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 30, 2000
items.q: "It’s called “Mr. Andrew J. Caddick.” I don’t know what track that is."

ctx.x: Something pretty funky? Did we do anything funky on there? It’s not funky but it’s really charming. It’s called “Mr. Andrew J. Caddick.” I don’t know what track that is.
I’ll have to look in there I think.
